checkedAlternates.risk: GDP Deflator includes GDP in its name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The GDP Deflator is a broad price-level index measuring inflation across domestic output (group-3), not an output/income aggregate (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Net exports are a component of GDP.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Current Account Balance tracks cross-border trade, primary income, and transfers (group-1), distinct from domestic output aggregates (group-4).
